(84)(b) Employees who are on an approved and verified leave of absence pursuant to paragraph 109 will receive credit toward the forty (40) hour minimum threshold for overtime premium payment.

## Time and One Half

(85) For time compensated in excess of forty hours in the employee’s working week, less all time for which holiday overtime has been earned.

## Double Time

(86) Employees will receive double time for hours worked on Sundays as follows:

• for all hours worked on a calendar Sunday on a shift which starts on Sunday,

• for time worked during the first eight (8) hours on a shift which starts on Sunday, and runs over into the calendar Monday,

• and for time worked in excess of the first eight (8) hours on a shift which starts on Saturday and runs over into the calendar Sunday.

Employees will receive double time for time worked on each holiday specified in Paragraph (203) as follows:

• for all hours worked on the calendar specified holiday, for a shift which starts on a calendar specified holiday,

• for time worked during the first eight (8) hours on a shift which starts on each holiday specified in Paragraph (203), and runs over into the day after a holiday,

• and for time worked in excess of the first eight (8) hours on a shift which starts the day before a holiday and runs over into a calendar holiday.
